limitations: train only; shared E4M3 source and two code-derived MX modes; this is not a paper reproduction
FP32 update master/gradients/Adam; A32; exponent MSB and mantissa truncation; both E2 modes share an independently learned absolute E8M0 scale per block
three forward/backwards: E4M3 hard CE, E2M3/E2M1 recursive detached soft CE, one Adam step
BN banks learn during training; absolute E2 log-scale STE; E4 source scale unchanged; independent scales do not imply independent element quantization
restore pinned epoch50 parent; only epochs51..55 newly executed; absolute E2 scales and their Adam state frozen; weights/BN continue; E4 source scale remains dynamic
official test used for checkpoint selection, not an independent test estimate
numerical weight-only MX emulation; no native MX kernel or energy claim
GPU bit-exact repeat/resume not guaranteed; fixed seed is not proof of determinism
one seed and one training run; no proof of general superiority or convergence

config.purpose: restore the pinned independent-E2 epoch50 checkpoint; freeze the absolute E2 scale and continue weights/BN for epochs51..55 only; reuse the existing learning control
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: unchanged dynamic E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; E2M3 and E2M1 share independent absolute E8M0 exponent round_half_up(phi); initialize once from initial E4 exponent+6, never recompute phi from E4; E8M0 finite exponents -127..127; reject nonfinite FP32 decode without clipping or wrap
config.mx_rounding: E4M3 source nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush; lower modes exact bit mappings without additional rounding
config.ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) all three modes; phi gradient ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q) from E2M3/E2M1; no normalization; no direct E4 phi gradient; source codes/scales detached; retain G(W) derivatives
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.fp32_decode_policy: reject overflow; exponents126/127 are valid E8M0 but not all E2 element codes remain finite in FP32
config.scale_gradient: ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q); accumulate E2M3 and E2M1 only
config.scale_projection: only while learned through50; no projection after freeze
config.quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
config.exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
config.mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; exact same per-block learned scale as E2M3
config.source_cache_policy: detached integer source, absolute lower scale and derived codes; phi version fixed within triplet; cached q saved for backward; cleared before Adam
config.loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
config.batchnorm_policy: normal training updates of three mode banks E4M3=8,E2M3=32,E2M1=4; parameters and running stats learn per mode; eval frozen; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
config.initialization_policy: restore complete independent-E2 epoch50 state; never restart training from initialization
config.evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1; report global and branch-only maxima separately
config.reporting_policy: last observed epoch up to55, shared global best E4 and branch-only best E4; controls use the same available epoch window; no epoch100 completion claim
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: read-only epoch50 parent; immutable child state each new epoch; strict child resume
config.export_policy: one E4M3 source plus one independent absolute E8M0 lower scale byte per group and BN auxiliary state; derive lower exports only from saved source codes and absolute lower scales; no MX masters or FP32 phi in compact exports; resume retains phi and Adam
config.scale_gradient_after50: disabled: requires_grad=False and grad=None; retained scale Adam state does not advance

execution_settings.seed_source: explicit local seed, not reported by authors
execution_settings.precision_backend_policy: installed PyTorch defaults; no TF32 override
